The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph (approx. 8.33 m/s) while a vehicle cuts in from the right (y=3.5m to y=0.0m) starting at x=20.4m with a forward velocity of 7.2 m/s. Since the ego vehicle is faster than the cutting-in vehicle, the gap will close rapidly. The cut-in maneuver takes 1.65 seconds, during which the ego vehicle travels approximately 13.75m and the other vehicle travels approximately 11.88m. The relative closing distance is small, but the lateral intrusion into the ego's lane (target y=0.0) creates a conflict. Given the ego's higher speed and the proximity of the cut-in, the ego vehicle must decelerate to maintain a safe following distance and avoid a collision or unsafe proximity. A2 typically represents a moderate deceleration or speed adjustment to accommodate the merging vehicle.
